product.title: Half Day Cabo Snorkel Adventure with Lunch and Open Bar

description.text: In Cabo San Lucas, this half-day snorkel covers two corridor bays with lunch and an open bar on board. Crew members handle snorkel gear, in-water timing, and a Land's End pass for the Arch so the group can stay with Santa Maria Bay and Chileno Bay rather than assembling boat and lunch tickets separately. Hotel pickup is listed for many Los Cabos properties. The outing is aimed at visitors who want a guided reef window with food service included. Seasonal whale sightings on the return are possible in winter but are not guaranteed. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cabo San Lucas, and the itinerary stays on the published bays and Arch rather than adding extra downtown shopping or a self-guided kayak hop.
